modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Hello there, everyone! Happy Sunday 😉 Here is another Kling 4.0 video. I finally got back home from work 😊 You can find the prompt below, as usual https://t.co/QzmtThQCZf

originalPrompt: Dozens of armored soldiers fight across an enormous desert battlefield beneath a gigantic alien ring megastructure. Every visible character is moving: infantry sprint between craters, two soldiers drag a wounded teammate toward cover, another group fires toward airborne enemies while robed figures run through the chaos. Suddenly the massive blue vortex beneath the megastructure activates and begins pulling soldiers, vehicles, sand and debris upward. Several characters struggle against the force, grabbing each other and nearby rocks. One soldier loses his footing and another catches his arm before he is pulled away. The camera moves rapidly through the battlefield between running characters, then rotates upward following debris toward the gigantic structure. Huge scale, continuous background action, realistic physical reactions, moving clothing and armor, explosions, atmospheric distortion, epic cinematic sci-fi warfare.
